description: Asks what Format returns for a Date (2024-03-05 14:07:09) under each date-pattern character and named date format (year, quarter, month names, weekday names, week of year, day of year, 12- and 24-hour clocks, minutes versus months, AM/PM and a/p markers, escaped slash, literal text) and for a bare date or time operand. Locale-dependent and recorded. Each call is its own snapshot SELECT expr FROM One. Fixture r-expr-1b-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
